read_by: Agent-drafted, from the cell's own tier table, capability and decision log
input: Water depth above local grade (m), finite and 0 or more; water type must be stated as fresh or saline; the PCS freshwater curve reads depth above the assumed 0.30 m entry (0 to 2 m knots, flat at full replacement beyond 0.6 m)
not_covered: Electrical balance including unit transformers and cables ($13.2M)
out_of_scope: Autonomous internal failures (not caused by the flood)

how_to_use.share_of: Hardware replacement value of the same physical unit, fixed real-2024 dollars: $901,380 active hardware per enclosure (80), $520,000 per PCS (20); $82.5M covered of $109.8M total

outputs.single_event: allowed: per-unit damage ratio for a stated depth and a stated water type (fresh or saline); unknown water or missing depth is withheld
outputs.scenario_dollars: allowed with the same-unit value and exposure stated; covered hardware only, never scaled to the whole plant
outputs.yearly_loss: conditional: Hazard computes it only if frequency, shared event, per-unit cap and missing-data checks pass; partial-property result only, complete-plant figures withheld

conditions: Pin the exact v1.0 artifact, value and profile; one value per unique physical unit
Use Hazard's existing inland annual-maximum or Coastal event-rate clock; no invented category probabilities
Interpolate depth before the response; apply the 0.30 m entry once
All units share one event; the plant stays fixed within the year
Cap each unit's yearly cost at its replacement value; no repair within the year
Keep missing source and response probability; do not turn unmodeled value into zero

method.summary: Conservative entry policy (replace once water is above 0.30 m) for battery enclosures, plus the Flood Solar inverter curve reused for the separate PCS; unit values from market cost shares of the fixed Hazard reference budget

key_sources: Hazard BESS reference r1: profile, layout and 2024 budget (BF-S01)
NEMA GD 1-2016, Evaluating Water-Damaged Electrical Equipment (BF-S02)
Flood Solar model v1.0 docs r4 canonical artifact (BF-S06)
SMA MV Power Station with Sunny Central Storage system manual (BF-S12)
NREL PVSCM 2024 Q1 cost model, ESS rows (BF-S13)
judgment: Water enters the enclosure and PCS at 0.30 m above grade (owner-approved policy, not measured)
Any entry means full replacement of the enclosure's active hardware (BF-Q01)
Saline water above 0.30 m means full replacement of enclosure and PCS hardware (BF-Q02)
Freshwater PCS damage stays at full replacement past the last source point (no deep-water data)
open_items: Coastal first SLOSH depth bin (0-1 ft) straddles the 0.30 m entry; upper-bin sensitivity kept for the spatial pilot
$27.29M of the plant value has no flood response yet
Matched service evidence, more mechanisms, restoration and size/duration scaling are future work

rows.variants: water: fresh or saline (same rule: full replacement once depth is strictly above 0.30 m)
rows.shape_basis: 0.30 m entry step is an owner-approved policy, not a fragility (BF-Q01)
rows.cost_basis: Full replacement on entry is policy; the $901,380 unit value split is T3

notes.text: Water assumed to enter at 0.30 m above grade
Conservative policy, not a calibrated mean

rows.variants: water: fresh (inverter curve on depth above 0.30 m entry) / saline (full replacement above 0.30 m)
rows.shape_basis: Flood Solar inverter knots (T3); the entry offset, deep plateau and saline step are T4
rows.cost_basis: Same-unit value $520,000 from market cost shares (T3)

notes.text: flood_solar v1.0 docs r4 (FS_INV inverter curve)
